iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Smithsonian describes isometric drawing as depicting three-dimensional objects with equal scales along three axes.

sources.title: Isometric Protractor Presented to Alexander Leslie
sources.publisher: National Museum of American History, Smithsonian Institution
supports: Isometric projection depicts three-dimensional form with equal scale on three axes, providing the style's non-negotiable spatial discipline.

sources.title: Architectural drawing
supports: Axonometric and isometric drawings can communicate spatial structure in a single image without conventional pictorial perspective.
